item.description:
Firstlight 0.2.7
- Connect your personal Spotify app to show what you are listening to and share music with friends. - Open Firstlight and your agents with customizable keyboard shortcuts. - Choose how much app and agent activity you share with friends and on your public page. - Improve live presence, menu-bar friend ordering and profile navigation. - Fix Bump lighting and smooth countdowns, period switching, notifications, onboarding and Settings feedback. - Speed up public profile pages and improve their maps.

Firstlight 0.2.6
- Adds public profile pages with a personal address and separate controls for what you share publicly. - Keeps friends, profiles and menu-bar presence in sync, with faster profile loading and more reliable recovery after connection errors. - Introduces a signed installer that installs Firstlight from the disk image and opens the app. - Refines onboarding, Bump reactions, menu-bar motion, Settings and update progress. - Improves agent usage counting and model recognition.

Firstlight 0.2.5
- Fixes an interface freeze when checking for updates or resizing the menu-bar panel. - Shows Up to date in the update button for two seconds after a successful check, then restores Check now. - Makes tab changes, activity charts, loading rows and agent cards transition more smoothly, including interrupted animations. - Refines invitation progress, group-join feedback, profile Bump controls and list separators. - Improves onboarding transitions, changing text and Settings status feedback.
